Follow the [guard contract](../../../docs/guide/guarded-workflow.md) first. It overrides legacy shared-state writes and same-turn execution. Save auxiliary notes under .omg/drafts/.

Run controller repair-context; require phase repair. It returns only the active
batch, real check log windows, expected behavior, exit codes and source references.
Honor group order and file scope. A group may contain multiple related validators;
the sealed repairGroups graph determines dependencies. Never add the backlog.
Normal care selects at most three groups (or fewer for elevated/critical care).
A repeated A-to-B-to-A failure state narrows the next batch to one group; progress
can clear this focus. Retry/stagnation limits and passed-file locks still apply.
Only the owner edits code. Verify and obtain fresh blind section receipts before
ending each repair execution. Missing capabilities use /oma-failure.
